[{"type":"text","text":"diff --git a/src/pages/systems/index.vue b/src/pages/systems/index.vue
index 5380b8e..4cfd45d 100644
--- a/src/pages/systems/index.vue
+++ b/src/pages/systems/index.vue
@@ -1,38 +1,144 @@
 <script setup lang="ts">
+import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
 import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
 import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
+import { useAuthStore } from '../../stores/auth'
+import { getToken } from '../../utils/request'
+import { fetchPortalApps, jumpToPortalApp, resolveResourceUrl, type PortalApp } from '../../utils/portalAuth'
+import { toastError } from '../../utils/notify'
 
 const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
+const isRemote = (import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE ?? 'demo') !== 'demo'
 
-interface SystemEntry { title: string; subtitle: string; icon: string; tone: string; target: string }
-const systems: SystemEntry[] = [
-  { title: '物业管理', subtitle: '项目台账 · 考评监管', icon: '/static/assets/d4dac.svg', tone: 'blue', target: 'workbench' },
-  { title: '房产交易', subtitle: '网签备案 · 资金核验', icon: '/static/assets/ec0ce.svg', tone: 'orange', target: 'housing' },
-  { title: '物业手持端', subtitle: '移动工单 · 现场巡检', icon: '/static/assets/25318.svg', tone: 'green', target: 'workbench' },
-  { title: '其他应用', subtitle: '知识智库 · 信用协同', icon: '/static/assets/bba9d.svg', tone: 'purple', target: 'home' },
+interface SystemEntry {
+  appId?: string
+  title: string
+  subtitle: string
+  icon: string
+  tone: string
+  target: string
+  authorized: boolean
+}
+
+// 演示模式静态数据（真实模式由 /apps 接口返回覆盖）
+const demoSystems: SystemEntry[] = [
+  { title: '物业管理', subtitle: '项目台账 · 考评监管', icon: '/static/assets/d4dac.svg', tone: 'blue', target: 'workbench', authorized: true },
+  { title: '房产交易', subtitle: '网签备案 · 资金核验', icon: '/static/assets/ec0ce.svg', tone: 'orange', target: 'housing', authorized: true },
+  { title: '物业手持端', subtitle: '移动工单 · 现场巡检', icon: '/static/assets/25318.svg', tone: 'green', target: 'workbench', authorized: true },
+  { title: '其他应用', subtitle: '知识智库 · 信用协同', icon: '/static/assets/bba9d.svg', tone: 'purple', target: 'workbench', authorized: true },
 ]
 
-function enter(item: SystemEntry) {
-  uni.reLaunch({ url: `/pages/${item.target}/index` })
+const systems = ref<SystemEntry[]>(isRemote ? [] : demoSystems)
+const loading = ref(false)
+const jumping = ref(false)
+
+const tonePool = ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'purple']
+
+function toEntry(app: PortalApp, index: number): SystemEntry {
+  return {
+    appId: app.appId,
+    title: app.appName,
+    subtitle: app.authorized ? '点击进入' : '未授权，请联系管理员开通',
+    icon: resolveResourceUrl(app.appLogo) || '/static/assets/d4dac.svg',
+    tone: tonePool[index % tonePool.length],
+    target: '',
+    authorized: Boolean(app.authorized),
+  }
 }
+
+async function loadApps() {
+  if (!isRemote) return
+  const token = getToken()
+  if (!token) {
+    // 会话失效：回到登录页重新走三重校验
+    uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
+    return
+  }
+  loading.value = true
+  try {
+    const apps = await fetchPortalApps(token)
+    systems.value = apps.map(toEntry)
+  } catch (cause) {
+    const msg = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : ''
+    if (msg.includes('登录已失效')) {
+      useAuthStore().logout()
+      uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
+      return
+    }
+    toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '子系统加载失败，请重试')
+  } finally {
+    loading.value = false
+  }
+}
+
+onMounted(() => { void loadApps() })
+
+/** 打开带票跳转地址（App 内用浏览器/WebView 打开；H5 下用新窗口） */
+function openRedirect(url: string) {
+  // #ifdef H5
+  window.location.href = url
+  // #endif
+  // #ifndef H5
+  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/workbench/index?redirect=${encodeURIComponent(url)}` })
+  // #endif
+}
+
+async function enter(item: SystemEntry) {
+  if (jumping.value) return
+  if (!item.authorized) {
+    toastError('未授权，请联系管理员开通')
+    return
+  }
+  if (isRemote && item.appId) {
+    // 真实模式：每次跳转都必须现取新票，禁止缓存 redirectUrl
+    const token = getToken()
+    if (!token) { uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' }); return }
+    jumping.value = true
+    try {
+      const redirectUrl = await jumpToPortalApp(item.appId, token)
+      openRedirect(redirectUrl)
+    } catch (cause) {
+      const msg = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : ''
+      if (msg.includes('登录已失效')) {
+        useAuthStore().logout()
+        uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
+        return
+      }
+      toastError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '跳转失败，请重试')
